hook_text: The land doubled in value — and the books refuse to show it. Here's the family behind that refusal.
clip_script: Meet the family. HISTORICAL COST is the grandfather who paid R650 000 for the farm in 2020 and will quote you that number till the day he dies — not what the neighbours say it is worth, what he PAID. PRUDENCE is the grandmother who counts the bad news early and refuses to count the chickens. MATERIALITY is the practical uncle who does not fuss over cents. The BUSINESS ENTITY RULE is the strict aunt with two purses that never mix. GOING CONCERN is the steady father who plants trees he will not sit under this year. And MATCHING is the meticulous cousin with the calendar.
visual_style: Six stylised family portraits appearing one by one around a farmhouse table, each with their principle name stamped beneath, ending in a full family photo.
pacing: One relative per beat, quick character sketches, family-photo finale.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and never forget a principle again.
